document.shape: One filled report per household. A filled report is one JSON object with exactly two keys, household and values (document.filled_report states the layout). household is {household_ref, as_of, first_data_date, accounts}: household_ref is the household's reference, as_of the report date, first_data_date the earliest first_data_date of its accounts, and accounts one entry per account of the household in ascending account_id order, each entry {account_id, account_id_form, last4, first_data_date, window_status}, where account_id is the issued opaque (minted) id and account_id_form is the text minted. values is an object keyed by member id with exactly one entry per member in members. A member whose grain is an account or an asset class holds {"by_row": {"<account_id or asset class>": figure}} (filled_report.per_row_member_form); a chart member holds a list of series {name, points: [{date, value}]}, a point with no measured figure left out, and a chart with no measured point holds its absent form. A value is a number, a text, or {"absent": "<reason in words>"}. A member whose source is ABSENT always holds the absent form, never zero and never a default. Units follow each member's unit: dollars as whole dollars with thousands separators; percent to one decimal place; text as written; series as the list the chart reads. A percent member holds PERCENT POINTS: a stored 1.5 means 1.5 percent, and a consumer must not scale it again (the unit_scale field on each percent member names this). The sample builder writes this object from the sibling contracts named in each member's source; the tab and the export read it by member id and print every absent form as its words. Neither the tab nor the export derives a figure from another source.

filled_report.per_row_member_form: a member whose grain is an account (the account value summaries, the activity account rows, the realized-lot members and the account gain-loss review) or an asset class (hold.allocation) holds {"by_row": {"<account_id or asset class>": figure}}, with one key per account of the household or per asset class; a figure is a number, a text, or the absent form {absent, kind}, and an asset-class entry the household holds none of is the text UNHELD (document.unheld_rule); a household-grain member holds its figure or its absent form directly, never a by_row map; an account key of a by_row map is the minted account_id
filled_report.window_status_rule: for each of the four windows (qtd, ytd, last_12_months, since_inception), with the window's opening anchor day (for since_inception, the account's first_data_date): NOT_SPANNED when the account has no account_return_daily row on the opening anchor day; BREAK when the opening anchor day is SOURCE_LAG, or when a day inside the window (after the anchor, up to and including as_of) has no row, a SOURCE_LAG row, a null total_return_daily or a GRADED_DISAGREED guard_state; else MEASURED, read from the account return table
filled_report.first_data_date_rule: an account's first_data_date is the business_date of its first row in the account return table, across every date= partition; the household's first_data_date is the earliest of its accounts' first_data_date values
filled_report.account_id_form_rule: account_id is the issued opaque (minted) id, ids.opaque_account(firm, custodian account id), the form of the client summary contract; account_id_form is the text minted on every account entry so a consumer rejects a custodian-form id by field; no custodian-form id leaves the function; the gold table's row_key keeps the custodian form and the reader mints it; the accounts are ascending by account_id (the minted id)

document.absent_rule: ABSENT is never zero. A figure with no value holds the form {"absent": reason, "kind": KIND} in values: the reason is printed in words, and KIND is one of document.absent_kinds. NO_SOURCE_YET: Opal has no source for the figure yet. INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: the source holds too little history for the period, and the remedy is time. SOURCE_BREAK: a source repair is the remedy, as for a missing row, a lagging row, a null return or a disagreeing guard. A member with source ABSENT carries NO_SOURCE_YET. A window with no measured figure prints its absent form; a window the account did not span (NOT_SPANNED) carries INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY and prints words, never the dash: the dash means only that the household holds none of the asset class (UNHELD). The kind is read from the kind field, never inferred from the reason text.
document.unheld_rule: An asset-class entry in a by_row map (hold.allocation) that holds the text UNHELD means the household holds none of that asset class on as_of. It prints the baseline's dash, never a reason and never zero. UNHELD is not an absent form, so it carries no kind, and it may appear only as the value of an asset-class key of a by_row map.

change_rule: a member whose source changes names the new field in the sibling's own versioned edit; a derivation the siblings do not carry (a household return series, a benchmark series, a month-to-date window, the registration name, the disclosure text) is a new field or a new contract before this contract sources it, and the contract changes by a version bump with the gap table re-bound to its bytes
read_rule: values are read by member id; an ABSENT member prints its reason in words; a figure is never derived from a source this contract does not name; the fee-basis words print beside every Opal return and gain figure and every baseline Net Gain figure Members of one equivalence class, for one entity, are all printed or all absent and agree where printed, and a figure printed under one member never reads unavailable under another (the equivalences list).
open_changes: the household return: Inflection is sourced at 0.5.0 from Orion's client-grain fact_performance factor (each window's return is the factor ratio, in percent points, opening day named per window in its member's firm_sources); every other firm stays ABSENT until its own source is named; a household daily return series built the way the account series is built remains a new contract

the four model benchmark return series: sourced at version 0.4.0 from the served dated model series (input model_portfolio_timeseries); the 32 benchmark members and the 12-month chart are compounded from its daily returns, each window's start stated in its fold; a figure whose window the series does not open on, or whose trading days it does not hold, prints its absent reason in words
month to date: a ruling is needed before a sibling carries it; until then the month-to-date members are ABSENT
the registration names and the disclosure text: no sibling holds them; the cover, account rows and disclosure page print absent forms

the since-inception convention: the baseline's conventions note says since inception is annualized past one year, while its Portfolio Value Summary row reads Return (Cumulative); the served figure is cumulative and is printed as cumulative until a ruling says otherwise

the account id spaces: the client summary holds issued opaque account ids, while the account tables key on the custodian account id; no sibling maps one to the other, so the masked account number on the cover cannot come from the summary alone
